'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Mike Richards DS Kessel: Spice Mines Administration Office''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel: Spice Mines Administration Office]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
